description: This file is a shell script used for testing the application of patches with various filename formats and scenarios related to the 'git apply' command, including handling of unusual filenames, whitespace, special characters, and diffs generated by Subversion.

methods.name: try_filename
methods.description: Defines a test for applying patches with different filename scenarios, verifying the correctness of the postimage after applying the patch.

methods.name: reset_preimage
methods.description: Resets the repository to the preimage state by checkout and cleaning the working directory.
